description:
About the Scholarship

Reading’s International PhD Studentships support research across its schools and Henley Business School. Applicants based at Reading can receive tuition and living support, alongside a training allowance. University of Reading invites applications for a PhD position in this area: International PhD Studentships at University of Reading 2027. Research areas covered include All Subjects. The host institution is in Reading, United Kingdom. Funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as £21,805/year. The stated deadline is 15 January 2027.

Research Areas

  • Eligible subjects across the university

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
FundingInternational tuition; GBP 1,000/year training allowance; UKRI-linked living stipend for Reading-based study.
MaintenanceGBP 21,805/year (2026/27 reference; Reading-based study only)
DurationUp to 4 years full-time; up to 6 part-time

Eligibility and Requirements

International PhD applicants with a suitable supervisor and admission application. Off-campus/distance awards do not include a stipend. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment2027 competition advertised
Deadline15 January 2027

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/GtuLx8aeZd

Source: forms.cloud.microsoft - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Contact the department, apply for PhD admission and complete the International PhD Studentship form. School nominees later submit a research summary of up to 700 words.

The funded living-cost route is for study based at Reading. An admission offer and a studentship award are separate decisions.

About University of Reading

The University of Reading offers doctoral research in science, life sciences, social sciences, arts and humanities, and through Henley Business School. Its Doctoral and Researcher College supports applicants with supervision guidance, research training and funding competitions.

Official details: Programme information

Application route: Application form or official instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.
